api_summary.title: Logos namespace boundary — runtime import and execution check
api_summary.brief: Import and smoke-execution hit 20-second timeout; compile and contract checks passed.
api_summary.summary: Runtime integration audit. The active Python environment resolves the logos namespace to a different package, causing direct Flamehaven-LOGOS import and pipeline smoke tests to time out at 20 seconds. Pipeline contract tests and export validation passed. LOGOS remains generator-only.
findings: Direct import and pipeline smoke execution: TIMEOUT (20s budget exceeded)
Namespace collision: logos resolves to a different package in the active environment
Safe boundary preserved: LOGOS remains generator-only; no verifier/promotion boundary breached
